info.title: Scholarion Campus API
info.description: Tenant-scoped API. Every path is under /api/campus/v1/t/{tenant}. Pagination: Link header (rel="next"). Concurrency: If-Match with the record version (412 on conflict). Admins may add ?as_user_id= to act as a user (audited). Local and staging only — demonstration data.

tags.name: Identity & Access
tags.description: Users, role grants, MFA and time-boxed support access.

tags.name: Curriculum
tags.description: Courses, sections, modules and accessible block pages with publish validation, prerequisites, blueprints and imports.

tags.name: Enrollment
tags.description: LMS access projection from SIS registrations, waitlists and reconciliation.

tags.name: Assessment
tags.description: Assignments, quizzes with snapshots and seeded randomization, question banks, attempts and submissions.

tags.name: Gradebook
tags.description: Weighted groups, drop rules, late/missing policies, versioned rubrics, posting, moderation, peer review and annotations.

tags.name: Collaboration
tags.description: Nested discussions with tombstones, scheduled announcements and a course-scoped inbox.

tags.name: Files & Media
tags.description: Signed short-lived uploads into quarantine, scan, MIME check, promotion; media renditions and required captions.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Minimized learning events, explainable risk signals and interventions.

tags.name: Integration
tags.description: LTI 1.3 tools, OneRoster sync jobs with diff reports, signed webhooks with retries, dead letters and replay.

tags.name: Admissions
tags.description: Applicants, applications, document checklists, review and decision letters.

tags.name: Registration & Records
tags.description: Terms, catalog, holds, validated registration (window, holds, prerequisites, conflicts, capacity, credits) and unofficial transcripts.

tags.name: Financial Aid & Accounts
tags.description: Charges, aid awards, sandbox payments and pay-as-you-go plans; overdue balances place holds.

tags.name: Calendar & Scheduling
tags.description: Projection of due dates, section meetings and personal events; revocable iCal feeds hashed at rest.

tags.name: Live Classroom & Attendance
tags.description: Zoom/Teams sessions through scoped connectors (disabled by default) and attendance imports reconciled by staff.

tags.name: Outcomes & Evidence
tags.description: Outcomes aligned to rubric criteria and questions, mastery rollups and evidence exports (demonstration only).

tags.name: Student Success & Advising
tags.description: Advisor caseloads from explainable risk signals, notes, referrals and interventions. People decide; signals never sanction.

tags.name: Course Evaluations & Surveys
tags.description: Anonymous end-of-term evaluations released only above a minimum response count.

tags.name: Credentials & ePortfolio
tags.description: Signed, revocable Open Badges 3.0-shaped certificates and student portfolios.

tags.name: Careers & Placement
tags.description: Job-ready profiles, opportunities and internships. Syncs to a separate placement database.

tags.name: Notifications & Preferences
tags.description: Branded templates, per-user channels, digests and quiet hours, fed by the outbox.

tags.name: Global Search
tags.description: Tenant-scoped, ACL-filtered search across courses, pages, people and help.

tags.name: AI Agent Control Center
tags.description: Agent definitions, versioned policies, evaluation gates, the human review queue and AI audit.

tags.name: AI Curriculum Engine
tags.description: Generates draft courses to the standard template; nothing is visible to students until a designer publishes.

tags.name: Cloud Lab (LTI 1.3)
tags.description: First-party LTI tool: signed launches from assignments, sandboxed runs and AGS score passback as unposted grades.

tags.name: Admin Console
tags.description: Accounts and sub-accounts, the permission matrix with locks, custom roles, themes and domains, feature options, global announcements, SIS import, act-as and connector enablement.

tags.name: Privacy & Compliance
tags.description: Observer consent, export and erasure requests, retention jobs and legal holds (holds block erasure).

tags.name: Help Desk & Support
tags.description: Tiered tickets, knowledge base, AI triage drafts and time-boxed delegated access.

tags.name: Operations & Observability
tags.description: SLOs, metrics, incidents, backups and point-in-time restore drills into isolated validation tenants.

tags.name: Marketplace
tags.description: Curated LTI tools and content packs; tenant-approved installs. Disabled by default.

tags.name: Mobile & Offline
tags.description: Offline reading packages and offline draft submissions with server-side conflict resolution.

tags.name: Accommodations
tags.description: Extra time, attempts and deadline extensions applied automatically to quizzes and due dates.

tags.name: People & Groups
tags.description: Roster, group sets with self sign-up and auto-assign, team assignments and the faculty journal.

tags.name: Library & Reading Lists
tags.description: Course reading lists with citations and accessible-format flags; feeds the AI Companion as assigned reading.

tags.name: Reports & Exports
tags.description: Enrollment, grade distribution, registration and engagement reports as CSV.

tags.name: Dashboard & Planner
tags.description: Card, list (planner) and recent-activity views, to-dos, coming up, recent feedback and global announcements.

tags.name: Mastery Paths, Assign-To & Pacing
tags.description: Differentiated due dates per section, group or student; conditional release by score; pace plans with blackout dates.

tags.name: Copy, Import, Blueprints & Sharing
tags.description: Course copy with date shifting, package import/export, blueprint sync with locks and history, and the shared content library.

tags.name: Developer Keys & API
tags.description: API and LTI 1.3 keys with scopes, OAuth2 tokens, rate limits, and the OpenAPI, GraphQL and gRPC contracts.

tags.name: Observers & Family
tags.description: Observers linked to students see consented grades, calendar and missing work, with alert thresholds.

tags.name: Account & Profile
tags.description: Profile, pronouns, accessibility settings, language and time zone, history, QR login for mobile.

tags.name: Catalog & Hub
tags.description: Product types, cohorts with seats-left, catalog pages generated from data (filters, cards, comparison, path diagram, structured data), a recommender quiz and the Catalog Copy Checker.

tags.name: Pathways & Transfer
tags.description: Program graph (prerequisite, stacks-into, waives, mutually-exclusive), credit transfer rules, rule evaluation at enrollment and issuance, and the automatic consolidation report.

tags.name: Commerce (sandbox)
tags.description: Quotes, coupons and referrals, early-bird, installments, subscriptions, corporate seats and invoices, simulated tax, refund/deferral policy engine, aid eligibility flags. Sandbox only — no real payments.

tags.name: AI Tutor
tags.description: Explain, hint, practice quiz and study plan from published course material with citations; refuses graded work; escalates to the instructor; language modes; avatar mode with disclosure, captions and transcript; erasable memory.

tags.name: Lab Key Vault
tags.description: Per-learner model API keys for labs with spend caps, rate limits and expiry; the master key is never exposed; calls are metered through the platform proxy.

tags.name: Tenant Console
tags.description: Platform operators: create tenants from templates (academy, university, school, corporate), region and tier, plan limits, suspend/resume/export/offboard, content licensing between tenants via blueprint copy, de-identified platform metrics.

tags.name: Connectors
tags.description: Zoom, Haven avatar/HavenConnect/HavenRoute, model providers, GPU pools, SSO, email — each with an honest status (LIVE / CONNECTED / DISABLED / SIMULATED / PLANNED), consent and secret references.

tags.name: Capability Status
tags.description: Every capability marked LIVE / CONNECTED / DISABLED / SIMULATED / PLANNED with evidence and blockers, plus the naming-migration checklist.

tags.name: Proctored Assessment Support
tags.description: Setup assistant that answers testing-environment questions with approved talking points only, a pre-test checklist that proctored assessments require, routing to the accommodations process, escalation with a response time, and a redacted question log for updating the talking points.
